ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
ex.t: 如今我们生活在一个被“做不到”态度包围的世界。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和悔恨。但我们仍须攀登，梦想山顶的风景。怪物可能出现，夜幕可能降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: The night before my marathon, I dreamt that I couldn’t even find the finish line.

ex.s: I gave the owner as much information as possible and headed home to see what news the night might bring.
ex.t: 我向主人尽可能多地提供了信息，然后朝家走去，看看那个夜晚会带来什么消息。

ex.s: A nervous night to be sure, but sometimes the spirits of nature smile on us all!
ex.t: 确是一个紧张的夜晚，但有时自然的精灵会眷顾我们所有人！

ex.s: If Tononi’s theory is right, it would explain why, when we miss a night’s, we find it harder the next day to concentrate and learn new information — our brains may have smaller room for new experiences.
ex.t: 如果托诺尼的理论是对的，就能解释为什么我们少睡一夜后，第二天更难集中注意力和学习新信息——我们的大脑可能为新体验留出的空间更小了。

ex.s: When life seems like one long night,And nothing is ever going right,There's just one sure delight:Friendship, like sunrise, warm and bright.
ex.t: 当生活漫长得像一个无尽的夜晚，一切似乎都永远不对劲，只有一种快乐是确定的：友谊，像日出一样，温暖而明亮。

ex.s: Benjamin could read only a little,having been a poor student.But he later said,”Those two books were my companions by day,and under my pillow at night.”While it is likely that he understood very little of the books,they were his introduction to classical paintings.The nine-year-old boy decided then that he would be an artist.

ex.s: I always wanted to know what my mom was reading． Hearing mom say，"I can't believe what's printed in the newspaper this morning，" made me want to grab it out of her hands and read it myself． I wanted to be like my mom and know all of the things she knew． So I carried around a book， and each night， just to be like her， I would pretend to be reading．
ex.t: 我一直想知道妈妈在读什么。听到妈妈说“真不敢相信今天早上报纸上印了什么”，我就想从她手里抢过报纸自己读。我想成为像妈妈那样的人，知道她知道的所有事情。于是我随身带着一本书，每天晚上，就为了像她一样，我还会假装在阅读。
